note: Echo's full signature chain, and the one card in the set that is genuinely novel. Haymaker is played for 2 (Rhino 14 -> 11) and tucked under Echo by Watch and Learn; then, holding Photographic Reflexes, the tucked Haymaker is played AGAIN out of the tuck pile at cost 0 -- its printed 2 minus the -2 the Reflexes grants -- discarding the Reflexes as the price, for 3 more damage. Rhino at 8 is the assertion: it requires both resolutions, the tuck, the replay-from-tuck-pile, and the discount, and no partial failure of that chain produces it. Note 60040a is deliberately LAST in hand: pick_payment walks the option's payment table in order and will happily spend Photographic Reflexes itself as a resource to pay for Haymaker, which burns the card and the case then silently measures nothing. Frame budget is load-bearing too -- at 36 frames this board still reads Rhino 11 with Haymaker nowhere, which looks exactly like a dead replay and is really a half-resolved read; it settles by 42.
